Great app but…. It is stuck at the readings page, and I cannot access any other part of the app.
As pops up every time I touch a card. Would be great if ads didn’t pop up every time I look at a card.

Deleted in less than 2 minutes!. I was interested in this app and downloaded it. The first thing you see is the 2021 spread. Then a request to pay for it all. There is no option to get to the main menu. I just wanted to see the cards. I’ll gladly pay for an app I like. This one is too annoying.

Great App. Love this App. I can’t say enough great about it. Absolutely no hidden agendas. Upgrade only if you want to and it’s not necessary. For a few bucks to me the upgrade was worth it. Other then that absolutely free. Great spreads and super accurate!!! Love love love

No meanings to the cards. The spreads are nice but there are no
Meanings to the cards even on the premium version. It directs you to click on the card for meaning but nothing pops up

Great update. This last update removed the intrusive ads that made it impossible to use it. Much better. You now can do some spreads without being harassed by ads. If you want new spreads you can buy them. Much improved. I’m glad I didn’t delete it.

The Great Lenormand Divination App!. First let me correct what several reviewers stated.. this app does NOT have any hidden fees as the other reviews suggested.. nor are there “individual” readings you need to purchase..it is free if you don’t mind dealing with a few ads that you get. I used this app two months before I made the purchase of the ENTIRE app not individually as some dishonest reviewers state these are people who are always looking for something free there is no way possible that a person can even buy one spread/layout reading individually because the APP is not set up in this way.. this is just simply untrue..there are three spreads offered free and when you make the purchase you are buying the whole app and so very glad I did purchase there are endless spreads on everyday mundane to needing the timing of an event.. to love, money, business etc .. for me $4.99 was worth keeping this app with its wealth of information without the ads. The developers don’t push anything on you, they give us a chance to experiment yes with ads and if you like the app it’s free to use with ads or purchase the App UNLOCK ALL and give family, friends or yourself readings that are HIGHLY ACCURATE! I am impressed with all the spreads and how it’s put together once you learn to navigate the different areas with the spreads everything just flows!! I can feel the energy of Mile Lenormand throughout the cards . She will live on as a Profound Psychic and Greatest Cartomancier Ever !!!
Zero stars. Free until you want a reading, then an "in-app" purchase. Stay away.
Hidden fees?. Not sure why but when I try to do some of the more advanced layouts it wants my Itunes password-like it's going to charge me. I deleted this app within 5 minutes due to this.

Not worth the money. You get access to a 1 card spread and have to pay extra for each 4 or 8 card spread you want. The card definitions were too brief and really didn't tell you much. I want my $ back, don't waste yours!
did not really like it.... it was nice to be able to do one card draws from my phone but the meanings are extremely innaccurate. birds as sadness? clover as being UNLUCKY? way off.
Disposition du tirage à revoir. Cela serait bien de pouvoir avoir les cartes en arrondit pour le tirage au lieu de les toucher les unes après les autres pour choisir

Expensive to unlock the spreads. The cards are very attractive BUT only the daily card with a short text is free. to unlock 4 card spread cost £1.49 and 8 card spread £1.99 - interesting text, longer than on daily cards, but not enough info on meaning of cards depending on their position in the spread, not able to save a spread. Expensive considering lack of features, I'm sure there are better tarot and oracle card sets for the same price.
